description: GLM-5.2 cost-optimized MSRT graph: the same K2 and K3 bases and the same 2-5 bpw product range as glm52-k2k3-dag.json, minus the two narrow-step stages (k2r1r1, k3r1r1). Seven quantization passes per weight matrix instead of nine: 7.946 s/matrix of measured trellis kernel time instead of 11.182, and 12 nominal trellis bits per weight instead of 14. What is given up is the +1-bit upgrade path for a consumer who already installed k2+k2r1 or k3+k3r1; the same final bitrate is still reachable by fetching the wider residual, at measured 9.0% (K2 family) and 6.8% (K3 family) LOWER error. See docs/MSRT-CAMPAIGN.md for the measurement and the cost of each menu.
